_comment: Draft archetype tags, for the four things kit data cannot express.
The ranker can already read a champion's class, damage type, crowd control and
whether it protects allies. What it cannot read from any of that is what a
COMPOSITION is trying to do -- and a draft is usually beaten by answering the
plan rather than the five champions separately. Fiora plus Twisted Fate is not
"a bruiser and a mage", it is side-lane pressure with a global follow-up.
Four tags, curated, because none of them survives derivation from tooltips:
aoeUlt          an ultimate that catches several people at once, which is
what makes a wombo composition a wombo
duelist         wins a sidelane 1v1 and can take a tower alone
globalPressure  a map-wide ultimate that makes a split push safe
poke            wins by chipping from outside engage range
This is a STARTER SET, deliberately conservative: a champion absent from a list
is treated as not having that property, which costs a little sensitivity and
never invents a threat. Add to it freely -- it is owner-maintained data in the
same spirit as champion_meta_overrides.json, and each entry is one name.
